description: Capabilities granted to the meeting card, the small always-on-top window in the corner that says a recording is about to start. It listens for the shell's events and calls only the two shell commands its page names (ui/src/recording/RecordingCard.svelte): the card it should show, and the answer to it. It was once part of `default`, with dialog, opener and notification grants it never used; it has none of them now.
